wikis.description: Information for wiki whose pages appear in the list, keyed by wiki ID.

api_url.description: Action API URL for this wiki

wiki.description: ID of the wiki where this page lives

is_local.description: Whether this is a local page

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the page was added to the worklist, if available.

timestamp_formatted.description: Timestamp of when the page was added to the worklist, if available, formatted for the current user

classes.description: CSS classes to add to a link to this page

pagination_offsets.description: Pagination offsets to use to get other pages of the result set. These are set iff it would make sense to go from the currently-requested result page to the page in question.

first.description: Set iff the user can navigate to the first page. The value is always null in that case.

prev.description: Offset to go to the previous page, if available

cur.description: Offset of the current page, if available

next.description: Offset to go to the next page, if available

last.description: Set iff the user can navigate to the last page. The value is always null in that case.
